name: stripe_api_key_recognizer
note: Stripe live secret (sk_live_) or restricted (rk_live_) key. Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/stripe.py, which matches exactly 24 characters after the prefix; current keys are often ~99 characters, so this matches 24 or more to redact the whole key. Test-mode keys (sk_test_) are not covered, as in the original.
